action_timeline.rationale: Require eastern lower roadblock destruction and completed opening interception.
Artillery must already be dead; this fixed withdrawal cannot be justified by an assumed refund after death.
Require the final lower outer queue to be dead before releasing this slot.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both medics are deployed, the opening lower central hostile is dead and Vanilla has withdrawn after her second grant.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An opening death or unfinished lower fight invalidates the economy, medical formation or later interception chain.
battle_phases.goal: Survive four opening approaches and establish reciprocal medicine.
handoff_requirements: Verify the lower opening fight is complete before creating the temporary central gap.
Keep both medical tiles available and fund their actual deployments.
responsibilities: Fang and Vanilla contain central runners; Midnight assists both lanes.
Midnight and Melantha intercept outer runners.
Hibiscus heals the opening central line; Ansel completes reciprocal coverage.
battle_phases.start_condition: Stage begins with 10 DP and no deployed operators.
survival_dependencies: Midnight must shorten the opening fights sufficiently for first healing.
Both vanguards must survive to their credited grants; neither death supplies a refund.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both eastern roadblocks are destroyed, Steward remains alive under actual impacts, Spot is installed and Beagle receives upper containment.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: A dead caster leaves artillery active; a dead medic removes both caster survival and later blocker support.
battle_phases.goal: Release eastern restraints and sustain dedicated artillery damage.
handoff_requirements: Spot must arrive before renewed lower pressure.
Require living Fang retreat and successful Beagle deployment.
Protected release must be followed by continued protection at the western restraint.
responsibilities: Midnight uses arts to destroy #3 while retaining upper interception.
Both medics heal Steward and Ansel's collateral damage; Ansel's extended range restores Midnight.
Fang stays through four grants before Beagle replaces him.
battle_phases.start_condition: Both medics are present and Midnight's first arts skill approaches readiness.
survival_dependencies: Moving Ansel adjacent to Steward improves coverage but creates shared shell exposure.
Skill timing must produce sufficient healing before impacts; unsupported extra healing targets are excluded.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Artillery is dead, pending impacts are survived, Lava is deployed and fresh Melantha owns lower interception and western clearance.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Artillery survival repeats the protected-target and medical failure chain; unfinished older armor consumes capacity needed by the final wave.
battle_phases.goal: Kill artillery and establish sustained central arts without losing interception.
handoff_requirements: Do not count Steward's retreat as artillery closure.
Require an affordable, off-cooldown Melantha deployment before releasing the lower queue.
Retain containment while Lava begins clearing armor.
responsibilities: Steward completes artillery damage and contributes where armored approaches enter his range.
Vanilla bridges the first lower officer pair until Melantha returns.
Midnight remains upstream; Lava begins single-target damage across both central blockers.
battle_phases.start_condition: Permanent blockers and reciprocal medicine are operating.
survival_dependencies: Both medical owners must survive the transition from artillery to ranged arts pressure.
Steward must remain alive through his required damage and retreat.

battle_phases.completion_condition: All outer hostiles are dead, final armored #34 has been blocked and killed, and no central enemy has escaped.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: Any leaked hostile fails acceptance even if both civilians later arrive; a single hit or block on #34 does not establish closure.
battle_phases.goal: Contain every final spawn and close both armored queues.
handoff_requirements: Steward returns only after cooldown and with a free deployment slot.
Release Vanilla's final slot only after her queue is dead.
responsibilities: Midnight combines his second arts window with continuous upper interception.
Lava clears central pressure; returning Steward supplies dedicated upper arts.
Melantha hands the remaining lower queue to fresh Vanilla.
Medics sustain blockers and each other through ranged arts exposure.
battle_phases.start_condition: Artillery duty has ended and the central formation is intact.
survival_dependencies: Midnight's outer targets may divert him from armor; central capacity must remain sufficient during those intervals.
Three-block capacity is a finite queue, not proof that later armor will be intercepted.

battle_phases.completion_condition: Both protected targets have safely arrived, zero protected deaths and zero leaks are recorded, remaining life is positive, spawns are exhausted and no active enemies remain.
battle_phases.failure_effect_on_later_phases: An unreleased civilian, protected death or remaining hostile prevents project acceptance.
battle_phases.goal: Release the remaining upper civilian and complete every terminal objective.
handoff_requirements: Require DEVICE_DESTROYED and subsequent PROTECTED_TARGET_REACHED events independently.
Do not terminate on the last spawn time or the last scheduled action.
responsibilities: Fang attacks western upper roadblock #1 from [1,3] LEFT.
Midnight remains upstream until upper hostile clearance is confirmed.
Both medics and both arts operators retain the final central formation through actual clearance.
battle_phases.start_condition: Final lower interception is complete and its slot is available.
survival_dependencies: The waiting upper civilian must have survived earlier officer and artillery exposure.
Fang must survive and actually destroy the roadblock; ordinary operators cannot move or heal the civilian.

corridor_responsibilities.responsibility: Steward owns artillery death before his scheduled withdrawal. Both medics own his survival and adjacent Ansel's collateral exposure. Confirm death and resolve all pending impacts.
Midnight clears eastern roadblock #3 during his first arts window. Keep him upstream of the civilian's western holding position. Fang later clears western #1; require actual protected arrival.
Opening Melantha clears eastern #4. Returning Melantha clears western #2 while the lower interception chain contains officers. Require actual protected arrival.
Fang hands upper containment to Beagle. Midnight and Lava supply shared damage; returning Steward supplies dedicated upper arts. Record living containment and actual deaths for both armored waves.

Vanilla hands lower containment to Spot after a verified opening clearance gap. Lava and available Midnight attacks must clear older armor before later arrivals exhaust capacity. Final armored #34 requires an actual block and death.
Midnight remains the upper outer interceptor. Ansel's extended-range windows restore him before sustained later pressure; no automatic central focus is assumed while he blocks officers.
Execute the four lower interception assignments with living successors. Release the final lower slot only after its queue is dead.

deployment_positions_and_directions.role: Opening upper containment and four conditional automatic DP grants.
Opening lower containment and two manual DP grants.
Persistent upper outer interception, eastern upper clearance and shared central damage.
Opening lower outer interception and eastern lower clearance.
First medic; ordinary coverage of both central blockers, Ansel, Steward and Lava.
Second medic; ordinary coverage of both central blockers, Hibiscus, Steward and Lava; boosted range reaches Midnight.
Dedicated eastern artillery damage followed by brief armored approach damage.
Permanent lower central three-block containment using ordinary attacks.
First lower outer officer bridge and later final lower outer interception.
Receive the lower queue, destroy western lower roadblock and intercept subsequent officers.
Persistent single-target arts covering both central blockers.
Sustained upper central arts after eastern duty and cooldown.
Destroy western upper roadblock after outer combat has ended.

formation_structure.artillery: Steward starts at frame 1953. His survival depends on actual healing packets under shell exposure, including collateral damage to adjacent Ansel. Hibiscus boosts from 2222 and 3723; Ansel boosts from 2403 and 4204. Aggregate HPS alone does not establish survival.
formation_structure.capacity: Ten selected IDs; at most eight simultaneous deployments. No deployment-limit exemption is needed.
formation_structure.central: Beagle and Spot retain three-block containment. Midnight covers both blocker tiles from [1,5] UP, but self-blocked outer enemies can divert him. Lava DOWN [5,5] covers both blockers without splash credit. Returning Steward adds dedicated upper arts.

economy.basis: Initial 10 DP, natural 1 DP/s, Fang opening cost 10 after the supported self-cost talent.
economy.cooldowns: Vanilla returns have more than 2100 frames after retreat; Melantha returns after 2134 frames; Steward returns after 2101 frames; Fang's final deployment has ample cooldown margin.
economy.credited_skill_income: Fang grants at 570,1320,2070,2820; Vanilla manual grants at 750 and 1650. Later income is unnecessary.
economy.refunds: Credit only successful living retreats: Vanilla 5, Melantha 7, Fang 5 and Steward 9 on their respective retreats.
economy.static_check: The declared ledger remains nonnegative; the opening minimum is zero. Death removes the associated refund and invalidates dependent handoffs.

formation_structure.medical: Geometry checks confirm Hibiscus UP [2,6] and Ansel DOWN [5,6] both cover Steward [5,7], both central blockers and each other. Lava moves to [5,5] so she remains covered by both medics. Ansel's active forward extension reaches Midnight [1,5].
formation_structure.opening: Retain Midnight's demonstrated opening assistance. Replace the first lower medic with Hibiscus at the upper medical position; deploy Ansel at the second medical position before the first artillery exposure.
formation_structure.outer: Midnight remains at [1,5] throughout hostile pressure. Lower interception passes Melantha to returning Vanilla to returning Melantha to final Vanilla. Fang is reserved for later western upper clearance rather than an exposed outer bridge.

formation_transitions.transition: Establish upper medicine covering both opening central operators.
Withdraw Vanilla after her second grant; the completed opening lower fight permits a temporary empty central tile.
Establish reciprocal medicine and two-healer eastern caster coverage.
Convert Midnight to arts for eastern upper clearance after his opening interception duties.
Begin dedicated artillery damage before its eastern circuit.
Install Spot before the next lower central wave reaches the line.
Replace Fang with Beagle after four opening grants.
Return Vanilla for the first lower outer officer pair.
Fresh Melantha receives the lower outer queue and western clearance duty.
Install Lava for sustained central arts after the intended artillery kill window.
Withdraw eastern Steward after artillery death and approach damage; existing projectiles remain live.
Midnight's second arts window combines final upper interception with opportunistic central armor damage.
Fresh Vanilla receives the final lower outer queue.
Return Steward to permanent upper central arts.
After final lower interception, Fang occupies the released slot and clears western upper restraint.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Selected/deployed union is at most ten, entirely from normal_low_star_catalog with rarity 1-3 and normal_mode true.
Every deployment uses integer [row,col], an allowed facing and the correct terrain. Never deploy on [[1,2],[6,2],[1,6],[6,6]].
At most eight operators are deployed simultaneously; same-tile handoffs execute retreat before deployment.
The first lower central hostile is dead before Vanilla leaves at 1651, and Spot is installed before the next lower central hostile can pass.
Both medics remain alive and actually heal the injured caster group before lethal impacts. Range coverage and average healing do not substitute for observed survival.
Artillery is dead before Steward's 4650 retreat. A surviving artillery unit makes this handoff fail; later refunds or skills do not repair it.
Retreat or artillery death does not erase already-created fixed-point shells. Survive their impacts.
Clear older central enemies before later runners and armor exceed block capacity. Require actual block and death for #21, #22 and #34.

Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Medics do not heal them. Prevent artillery death and excessive officer damage; destroy both restraints on each protected route and confirm both arrivals.
Every outer replacement must be alive, affordable and off cooldown. Midnight remains upstream while the first civilian waits at western #1.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected deaths and both expected protected arrivals. Record operator deaths separately.

pressure_window_responsibilities.duties: Survive all opening lanes, collect the declared grants, finish the first lower central fight and establish both medics.
Clear both eastern restraints, start artillery damage, sustain shell exposure and replace the upper vanguard without losing containment.
Protect both civilians, intercept the first outer officer pairs, finish artillery and establish central arts while preserving medical continuity.
Kill older armor before capacity saturation, intercept every final spawn, restore dedicated upper arts and close final armored #34.
Finish western upper clearance, confirm both protected arrivals and maintain the final formation until all hostile and spawn obligations are exhausted.

skill_intents.intent: Opening automatic grants fund the formation. Final western clearance uses ordinary attacks; no later income is required.
The first two activations supply necessary opening income. The final activation improves final lower interception; its income is not required.
First arts window clears eastern upper restraint. Second window accelerates final upper officers and central armor during actual acquisition gaps.
Boost before eastern caster shell exposure, then sustain overlapping shell and armored pressure. Full active duration and recharge are included.
Boost shared caster healing and reach Midnight during opening recovery, first later officers and final upper pressure. No extra healing target is credited.
Reduce physical pressure while armor is cleared. Do not credit DEF against enemy arts.
Accelerate returning lower interception before the fresh Vanilla handoff.
Accelerate single-target central arts. Initial readiness uses the supported 30 deployment SP; subsequent cycles include active duration.
Ordinary arts and automatic attack-SP skill only; no chosen target order or unsupported talent benefit is required as a tactical guarantee.
Ordinary blocking and attacks only; unsupported healing mode and evasion are excluded.

tactical_thesis: Repair artillery survival with earlier reciprocal medicine and two ordinary-range healers covering Steward. Keep Midnight upstream throughout combat, activate his first arts window for eastern upper roadblock clearance, and use his later arts window to supplement central clearance between outer interceptions. Preserve lower western clearance through Melantha, then assign Fang to upper western clearance after the final lower interception. This is an unexecuted full-stage hypothesis.
